name: What questions should I ask a design-build firm before hiring?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a design-build firm before hiring?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a design-build firm before hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best hiring questions focus on accountability and clarity. Ask whether the firm uses in-house designers, architects, and project managers or outside partners. Ask when pricing starts, how allowances are calculated, and how often the budget is reviewed during design. Confirm who handles permits, what exclusions are common, and how change orders are approved. It is also smart to ask about similar projects in your neighborhood, especially if your home has hillside conditions, older construction, or luxury finish expectations. For Los Angeles homeowners, response time and communication style matter just as much as design taste. A good firm should be able to explain how they handle surprises, long-lead materials, and revisions without hiding behind vague promises. The goal is to find a team that is transparent before the contract is signed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask who handles design, pricing, permitting, change orders, and project management; what is excluded; how allowances are set; and how often the budget is updated. You should also ask for examples of similar projects and how the firm handles delays or site surprises.
